correctness.rationale: RESULT.md blob 1460c5: normalized two-point spherical Blaschke-Petkantschin identity has factor 1/2 and |sin(u-v)| Jacobian (F=1 reproduces 16pi^2). A forbidden south-cap arc of length 2h leads to ordered crossing integral I(h)=2(pi-2h-sin(2h)); integrate normal coordinate z in [0,sin beta] to obtain P_unconditional=(sin beta-sin^2 beta)/4. Divide by cap mass squared ((1+cos beta)/2)^2 to get 0.5*t*(1-t)^2, beta=pi-rho, t=tan(beta/2). Concavity derivative (1-t)(1-3t)/2 yields unique 2/27 max; hemisphere/full-sphere and epsilon^2/2 vs epsilon/4 endpoints checked. Independent numerical quadrature for beta=0.13,0.35,0.7,1.25 agreed to <3e-15. Finite integration verifies normalization, not continuum proof alone.
